mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM SMT_PARK WHERE ID=#{parkId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM SMT_PRINT_BIND_RULE ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC,BINDING_RULE_ID
SELECT * FROM SMT_PRINT_BIND_RULE WHERE PARK_ID=#{parkId} AND PRINT_ITEM_TYPE=#{printItemType} AND PERSON_TYPE=#{personType} AND CLASSIFICATION_CODE=#{classificationCode} AND STATUS='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_PRINT_BIND_RULE SET PARK_ID=#{parkId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},PRINT_ITEM_TYPE=#{printItemType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},PERSON_TYPE=#{personType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},CLASSIFICATION_CODE=#{classificationCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},SCOPE_TYPE=#{scopeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},SCOPE_ID=#{scopeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},TEMPLATE_ID=#{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},PAIR_ID=#{pairId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},EMPLOYEE_GRADE_CODES_CLOB=#{employeeGradeCodesClob,jdbcType=CLOB},PRIORITY=#{priority,jdbcType=NUMERIC},VALID_FROM=#{validFrom,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},VALID_TO=#{validTo,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},STATUS=#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR},REVISION=#{revision,jdbcType=NUMERIC},UPDATED_BY=#{updatedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR},UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE BINDING_RULE_ID=#{bindingRuleId} AND REVISION=#{revision}-1
